title: Ginger Persian mix cat 'Milo' missing near Lake Road
description: Wearing a soft teal breakaway collar with a bell. Very gentle but shy around loud rickshaw horns. Last seen near Dhanmondi Road 10A gate.

sightings.note: Saw an orange fluffy cat with a green/teal collar under a parked car around 6:30 PM.

title: Friendly brown Indie puppy found with blue nylon collar
description: Found safe near Sector 7 Park mosque. Well-fed and clearly someone's beloved pet. Currently kept safely in our garage with water and food.

title: Tame yellow & grey Cockatiel 'Koko' flew out from balcony
description: Responds to whistling and his name 'Koko'. Has bright orange cheek patches. Flew towards Avenue 3 trees.

title: Calico adult cat rescued near Panchlaish residential lane
description: Spotted meowing near the gate, litter-trained and wearing a pink collar without a tag. Looking for her family.
